intro: Oben Rageclaw is the restless spirit of a night elf druid haunting the corrupted depths of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den in Teldrassil. While his spirit wanders trapped in the barrow den, his slumbering physical form has fallen under the sway of foul furbolg magic.

p: Like many Druids of the Claw, Oben Rageclaw retreated into the subterranean sanctum of Ban'ethil Barrow Den to commune with nature and wander the Emerald Dream. However, when the native Gnarlpine furbolgs fell to corruption and overran the barrows, Oben was caught entirely defenseless in his trance. Rather than simply slaying him, the corrupted Gnarlpine shaman used dark rituals to seize control of his comatose mortal frame, leaving his displaced spirit lingering as an anguished ghost unable to pass on or wake.
